latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Core v2 RUN57: generalize truth-bound promoted claim contract
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: A reusable source-neutral promoted-claim contract now carries a claim only when its complete materiality -> FactKernel -> writer projection -> writer consumption -> article-claim -> document lineage is identity-bound. A separate validator reconstructs the canonical lineage and deterministic contract ID from independently supplied expected truth, so a tampered envelope cannot self-certify even if it recomputes its own ID. The interface is SHADOW-only and grants no article mutation, site, social, production, merge, deployment or acceptance authority.
